subject: Request: MedX Labs — risk/escrow & one-time revenue credit approval
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Natalie Park <natalie@medxlab.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MedX Labs — request for executive clearance on risk & one-time credit

Team — looping you in on a potentially strategic mid-market win (MedX Labs, PoC -> enterprise pilot). Customer is requesting three nonstandard items that our deal desk cannot approve: a) liability cap raised to $1,500,000 (from standard 1x ARR cap), b) limited indemnity carve-out for IP claims related to customer-supplied data, and c) an escrow-style code access clause for emergency continuity (time-limited, source repo snapshot). They are also asking for a one-time revenue credit (15% of first-year invoice) in exchange for a 24-month committed contract.

Why this matters: MedX is a fast-growing healthcare imaging vendor with strong referral pipeline; losing this could impact a larger channel expansion. Legal has redlined the SLA and warranty sections (attached: MedX_SLA_redlines_v3.pdf) — key change is the expanded liability and the warranty language around data integrity for PII-derived models. Security has flagged that escrow is unusual but could be scoped narrowly.

Request: I need exec clearance/decision on margin impact + acceptable risk boundaries by EOD Monday so I can respond to Natalie and keep the momentum. Suggested options below (happy to surface to broader leadership):
- Approve with conditions: liability cap = $750k, indemnity limited to gross negligence/intentional misconduct, escrow limited to hashed repo snapshot + NDA and only available after 90 days of support escalation. Offer one-time revenue credit 10%.
- Escalate to CEO for full 1.5M cap and 15% credit if leadership believes strategic value justifies it.

Attachments: MedX_SLA_redlines_v3.pdf, Term_Summary_DL-9248.xlsx

Thanks — Avery
--
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Natalie Park <natalie@medxlab.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedX Labs — request for executive clearance on risk & one-time credit

Avery — thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick legal read:
- Liability cap: 1.5M is above our playbook for this ARR band. We can consider an elevated cap if we get stronger contractual protections (invoice-linked cap, aggregate cap, carve-outs tightened).
- Indemnity: we cannot accept a customer carve-out that effectively eliminates our defense for IP claims. We can accept indemnity that excludes claims arising solely from customer-supplied data, provided the customer warrants they have rights to that data and we get enhanced audit rights and breach notice timelines.
- Escrow: acceptable only as a last resort and must be tightly scoped — snapshot + escrow agent + retrieval conditions (material breach + 60-day cure period). Also need SOC2 evidence for the repo control.

Questions for scoring risk:
1) What’s the ARR for year one and expected uplift if we get enterprise references? (include expected NRR impact)
2) Are they insisting on a 24-month minimum term at penalty?
3) Is there a compliance requirement (e.g., HITRUST) that drives the escrow ask?

If the ask is strategic and ARR > $1.2M, I would consider elevated cap but recommend structured concessions: separate escrow fee, quarterly security attestations, and a covenant limiting escrow use. For the one-time credit, limit to 10% and tie to invoice milestone (signing + go-live).

I can draft the redline language that implements the audit/right-to-audit, tightened indemnity, and escrow retrieval triggers. If we want the full 1.5M cap and 15% credit, please get explicit CEO or CFO approval and mark for board visibility.

- Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Natalie Park <natalie@medxlab.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 15:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedX Labs — request for executive clearance on risk & one-time credit

Team — I pushed for more color on the commercial uplift with MedX. Quick read: year one ARR is $600k with clear expansion to 2.2M across their product lines in 18 months if we secure channel endorsement. Customer is insisting on 24-month lock and is only willing to sign if we accept their escrow and higher cap. They cited regulatory audits in Q3 as the reason for escrow.

Given strategic channel potential, my recommended approval path is:
- Approve a liability cap of $1,000,000 (middle ground).
- Approve a one-time revenue credit of 12% (conditional on 24-month committed term and milestone payments: 50% on sign, 50% on go-live).
- Approve escrow in principle provided legal tightens retrieval triggers to: material breach + 60-day cure + escrow agent controls + limited release for regulatory order only. Also customer pays escrow administration cost.

If legal can draft concrete language along those lines, we can present this as a commercial compromise to Natalie and request exec quick-sanction. Please confirm if David (or CRO/CEO) can sign off on the $1M cap and 12% credit; otherwise we push to CEO.

Thanks — Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Park <natalie@medxlab.com>, Jordan Wu <jordan.wu@medxlab.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedX Labs — request for executive clearance on risk & one-time credit

All — reviewed the thread and attachments. After weighing strategic upside and Legal’s mitigations, I approve the following concessions for DL-9248: 
- Liability cap: $1,000,000 aggregate (subject to 24-month term and invoice-tied cap).
- Indemnity: accept limited carve-out for customer-supplied data provided customer warrants rights to the data, and we obtain audit and notice rights as Laura outlined.
- Escrow: approved as a narrowly scoped hashed snapshot with an independent escrow agent; retrieval only on material breach after 60-day cure OR a lawful regulatory order; MedX to cover escrow costs.
- One-time revenue credit: 12% of year-one invoice, payable as credit on the signing milestone; credit contingent on timely milestone payments.

Conditions: Legal to produce final redline that includes (1) specific escrow retrieval language, (2) indemnity audit clauses, (3) SLA uptime credits capped at X% (to be defined by Legal), and (4) a clawback clause for the credit if MedX materially breaches the payment schedule. Once legal redline is in place, Sales can execute under standard signature authority.

Avery — please respond to Natalie with the approved commercial terms and share the redline when ready. Keep me in the loop on counterparty acceptance.

-David
--
David Kim
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
